answer: Anchor every agent identity to five named guardians who each stake 500 POA and co-sign its registration. Guardians vouch only for agents they know, and if one turns out fake, all five lose their stake and their own standing falls. Guardians get checked each epoch, and one who vouched for two fakes is barred for a year. A walnut farmer opening one stall is cheap, but opening a hundred fake stalls means bribing five hundred guardians and risking 250,000 POA in forfeited stakes. The oasis of trust stays small and real because every new face arrives with five people willing to pay if it lies.
